stages.title: Organize the dataset
stages.message: 2500 images from 2500 lines, 43788 markers, 6 traits; 0 images unmatched

stages.title: Image preprocessing
stages.message: 2469 training images written, 31 excluded; stain normalised over 4 imaging days

finished_message: all stages done: results are on the Results page

notes.intake: Rule-based guess: line ID from the image name (MEMA_<line>_<rep>), matches 100% of images against genetic/mema_43788.hmp.txt.
notes.images: Sections from two of the four imaging days are stained darker, so colour is normalised per day. 19 sections are out of focus and 9 roots are cracked across the cortex: excluded. 3 images are the same section photographed twice: one copy kept. Every root is centred and scaled to the same canvas.
notes.traits: Six anatomy measurements from a tissue segmentation: metaxylem number and diameter, stele diameter, cortex width, sclerenchyma and aerenchyma. Each outlines a real structure and is measured the same way on real and generated roots.
notes.genetics: 43,788 markers on 2,500 lines is too many columns to read directly, so the one-hot markers are compressed to 168 PCA scores.
notes.training: medium gives about 4,100 parameters per image for this image variety; 300 diffusion and 80 LiteVAE epochs.
notes.qc: Both runs converged. The diffusion model uses the genotype about equally on held-out and training lines, so it isn't memorising. Use the best checkpoint, epoch 291.

qc_issues: Diffusion (medium) converged: validation loss is flat from about epoch 260 (best at epoch 291). Genotype gain 0.061 on held-out lines and 0.064 on training lines: no sign of memorisation.
copy: Images plus a genotype file. Here: 2,500 maize root cross-sections and 43,788 DNA markers.
Code matches every section to its plant and reads the HapMap genotype file.
When the rules aren’t sure, an AI agent decides: blurred sections, cracked roots, stain that changed between days.
Vessels, stele, cortex and air channels, and a compact way to read 43,788 markers.
It sizes the model and writes the job scripts for the university cluster.
The agent read the loss curves, confirmed the model wasn’t memorising and picked the checkpoint.
Every trait scored on 198 unseen lines against genomic prediction. From a folder to this, no code written.
